newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Rosenbauer sees fall in 1996 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Rosenbauer sees fall in 1996 net profit.

text.p: Austrian fire engine maker Rosenbauer International said on Thursday it expects 1996 net profit to fall by half because of a higher tax burden and one-off costs from the partial closure of one subsidiary.
"Net profit will be between 22 and 25 million schillings," finance chief Robert Kastil told Reuters. Last year's net profit was at 46.5 million schillings.
The company said it expected pre-tax profit to remain flat at around last year's level of 65.5 million schillings, while sales should inch up to two billion schillings from 1.94 billion in 1995.
Rosenbauer added it would keep its 1996 dividend steady at 15 schillings a share. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
